title: Who Had It Better? The Generational Money Showdown | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Is the American Dream getting more expensive, or is Gen Z just more sensitive? Jill and Mark break down the data to settle the generational debate once and for all: Which generation is actually better off financially? Place your bets! Plus, a TikTok takedown featuring some financial advice from a reality TV star…You don't see that every day.
